title: Page 2
content_zh:
「唔……」他沙哑地低吟出声。
「霆儿？」在床旁照顾的太后姜鸳一改愁容，欣喜地漾起笑，抚摸着爱子的脸庞。「身子有没有感到舒服一些？」
他瞧着年轻且美丽的母后，虚弱地问：「母后，儿臣昏睡多久了？」
「已整整三日了。」姜鸳欣然说道：「霆儿，好好休养，相信母后，从现在开始，你的身子会越来越好，与寻常人无异。」
「为什么？」他已经病了十五年，如果能好早就好起来了。
「反正这段时间你先好好休养就是，有什么问题，咱们之后再说吧……」
兰霆已无心思考，因为他的意识又逐渐涣散，眼眸缓缓闭起，再度陷入沉睡了。
之后，他的身子真如母后所说一样，逐渐康复起来，经过好几个月的精心调养后，他原本瘦弱的身子已经养出点肉来，气色也愈来愈好。
一年多前父王驾崩没多久他就已继承王位，但他光生病就耗去所有心力，根本无力处理政事，因此政事几乎都是母后在帮忙摄政处理，直到最近他的精神越来越好，终于能够开始慢慢参与朝政。
他对自己日渐强壮的身子很开心、很满意，母后也很开心，甚至兰凌国百姓们也跟着欣喜，乐见他们的新王终于康复起来。
冬去春来，兰霆的身子在经过半年多的调养之后，已和正常人没什么两样，他见外头天气晴朗，兴起想出去走走的念头。
他遣退随侍的宫女，独自一人离开居住的寝殿，在王宫里信步走着，之前因为病弱，他始终没办法将整座王宫都好好地看过一遍，现在终于有这个机会了。
他走进一处正盛放着桃红花朵的樱花林里，出神地望着眼前花瓣纷飞的美景，以至于没注意到身后有人正朝他的方向跑来。
小女娃喘呼呼地跑进樱花林里，正想找个地方躲起来，不料前方竟有个少年背对她而立，她来不及停下脚步，整个人硬生生地朝他撞了过去。「啊——小心！」
「呃？」兰霆一回过身，小女娃的头硬是撞上他的肚子，那冲撞的力道害他踉跄地退了好几步，气得怒骂出声。「该死！是谁胆敢冲撞本王？」
「哎呀！」小女娃一屁股跌坐在地上，疼得暂时起不了身，她揉着疼痛的屁股，在看清楚他的样貌后，原本紧皱的小脸蛋倒是漾起兴奋的笑意。「王，是王耶！」他看起来气色真好，身子已经完全康复了吧？真是太好了。
「你……」他困惑地微蹙起眉，对她的面貌有些熟悉，想了一会儿才想起来，她正是他半年多前在湖边遇到的那个无礼小女娃。「你怎么还在宫里？」
他讶异地瞧着她，发现她比他在半年前看到的要虚弱好多，原本圆润的脸蛋已经消瘦下来，苍白的脸上病气十足，而且额心多了一点鲜红色的印记，唯一不变的是她那灿烂的笑容，比阳光还要耀眼夺目。
「我本就没有要走呀。」宗雪莹坐在地上不断喘气，就连说话的语气也显得有气无力的。
「为什么？」他眉蹙得更紧，不懂是谁让她留在宫中的？目的又是什么？

「可以下回再说吗？」她努力想站起身，却使不上力气，左摇右晃的，像是随时会跌回地上。「我现在得赶紧找个地方躲起来。」
「你到底在搞什么？」看到她如此虚弱，他赶紧抓住她的手，免得她真的跌坐回去，但嘴巴依旧不饶人。「你是做了什么亏心事，才怕被人找到？」
或许是因为曾经同病相怜，知道生病的痛苦，他才会忍不住伸手帮她，要不然他才不想理这个来路不明的小女娃。
她的虚弱让他内心泛起了一股复杂的感受，不懂短短的半年时间，为什么他的身体痊愈了，而原本健康圆润的她却病得如此虚弱？
「我才没做什么亏心事，我只是……偷跑出来喘口气而已。」她有些心虚地轻吐舌尖，尴尬一笑。「要不然娘和朵儿都不让我踏出房门，我都快被闷死了。」
瞧她一脸无奈的表情，他心口突然有种微微刺痛的感觉，不由得对她产生怜悯，因为他懂她的无奈，他也曾经如此，那种只能关在房里足不出户的窒闷感，直到此刻，他还是能够深深体会。
「既然身子不舒服，何必逞强跑出来？」他虽能体会那种苦闷，但看到她如此不爱惜自己的身子，他还是气得忍不住骂她。
「你不也一样？为什么你可以，我就不行？」她倒也回得理直气壮，一点都不把他当王看。
「什么？你……」居然敢顶他的嘴？她真是不要命了！
「王，我可以问你一件事吗？」她的唇色泛白，看起来气色似乎比刚才更加糟糕。「一个人要昏倒前，是不是眼前所看到的东西会越来越白，几乎快要睁不开眼？」
兰霆惊诧地喊道：「你别告诉本王你要昏了！」
「我也不想，但我……真的……撑不住了……」话一说完，她眼一闭向后软倒，果真当着他的面昏了。
「小丫头！」兰霆讶异地往前扑抱住她，护着她一同坐倒在地，没让她摔着、撞伤任何一处，他轻拍她的脸蛋，想唤醒她，却没想到她的肌肤好冷，几乎摸不到什么温度。
他深受震撼，因为这状况……和他之前还病着时好像，几乎一模一样……
「小姐——」
「莹儿，你在哪儿？莹儿——」
朵儿和另一名年轻貌美的妇人急急跑入樱花林里，恰巧见到宗雪莹昏倒在兰霆怀中的景象，她们俩轻喘着气，停在一旁，没料到居然会在这儿遇上兰霆，两人心下一惊。
年轻的美妇是宗雪莹的亲娘——宗薰，她先恢复镇定，朝兰霆有礼的躬身。「王，可以把莹儿还给我吗？她现在身子虚弱，不适合在外头待太久。」
「你认得本王？」兰霆微蹙起眉，他对她一点印象也没有。
「我当然认得。」宗薰淡淡一笑。

「她到底怎么了？为什么才不过短短半年而已，就病成这样？」
「我想……也是时候该让王知道了。」宗薰语气柔缓的说道。「请让我先把莹儿带回房里，之后王和莹儿之间的关系，我会尽力解释，好让王明白。」
兰霆困惑地瞧着宗薰，不懂她到底在卖什么关子，但碍于宗雪莹正昏迷着，他只能点头让宗薰赶紧将她带走，免得耽误了她的救治。
他和这个小丫头之间能有什么关系？他就等着听她如何解释。
兰霆跟着宗薰她们来到宗雪莹目前所居住的寝殿里，看着宗薰小心翼翼地将宗雪莹放上床，替她盖上被子。
没过多久，太后姜鸳也来到寝殿内，吩咐宫女们搬来三张椅子，让他们就近坐在床旁，把事情说个明白。
姜鸳对兰霆说道：「霆儿，她是隐族的族长宗薰，也是宗雪莹的娘亲，更是让你身体康复之人，之前一直没有机会告诉你，不如就趁这当下，一并向你说明白吧。」
「母后，儿臣不懂，她是如何让儿臣身体康复的？」兰霆一直以为是御医找到新药方，才让他的身子慢慢好转，没想到完全不是这么一回事。
宗薰开口解释。「真正的说法应该是，莹儿代替王承受了病厄，所以王才会日渐康复，换莹儿被病魔所扰。」
隐族是一个神秘的小部族，代代相传许多神秘术数，因而被各国所觊觎，隐族为了躲避各国追索，行踪飘忽不定，居无定所，才会有「隐族」这个称号。
content_en:
"Hmm..." he whispered hoarsely.
"Ting'er?" Queen Mother Jiang Yuan, who was taking care of her by the bedside, changed her sad expression and smiled happily, stroking her beloved son's face. "Do you feel better?"
He looked at the young and beautiful Queen Mother and asked weakly: "Queen Mother, how long have you been sleeping?"
"It's been three days." Jiang Yuan said happily: "Ting'er, take a good rest. I believe my mother, from now on, your health will get better and better, and you will be no different from ordinary people."
"Why?" He has been ill for fifteen years. If he could recover, he would get better soon.
"Anyway, you just need to take a good rest during this period. If there is any problem, we can talk about it later..."
Lan Ting no longer had the intention to think, because his consciousness gradually faded away, his eyes slowly closed, and he fell into a deep sleep again.
After that, his body gradually recovered as his mother said. After several months of careful nursing, his originally thin body had gained some muscle, and his complexion was getting better and better.
He had inherited the throne not long after his father's death more than a year ago, but his illness consumed all his energy and was unable to deal with political affairs. Therefore, his mother was almost always helping the regent to handle political affairs. Until recently, his spirits were getting better and better, and he was finally able to slowly start to participate in government affairs.
He was very happy and satisfied with his increasingly strong body, and his mother was also very happy. Even the people of Lanling Kingdom were also happy and happy to see that their new king finally recovered.
Winter turned to spring, and after more than half a year of recuperation, Lan Ting's body was no different from a normal person. Seeing the sunny weather outside, he thought of going out for a walk.
He dismissed the accompanying maids, left the dormitory where he lived alone, and walked around the palace. Because of his illness, he had never been able to take a good look at the entire palace, but now he finally had this opportunity.
He walked into a cherry blossom forest with pink flowers in full bloom. He was so absorbed in looking at the beautiful scenery of the petals flying in front of him that he didn't notice someone behind him running in his direction.
The little girl ran panting into the cherry blossom forest and was just trying to find a place to hide. Unexpectedly, there was a young man standing with his back to her in front of her. She didn't have time to stop and she bumped into him. "Ah - be careful!"
"Huh?" Lan Ting turned around, and the little girl's head hit his stomach. The force of the collision made him stagger back several steps, and he cursed angrily. "Damn it! Who dares to collide with me?"
"Oops!" The little girl fell to the ground, unable to get up from the pain. She rubbed her painful butt. After seeing his appearance clearly, her wrinkled little face revealed an excited smile. "King, it's the king!" He looks really good, has he fully recovered? It's so good.
"You..." He frowned slightly in confusion, feeling a little familiar with her face. After thinking for a while, he remembered that she was the rude little girl he met by the lake more than half a year ago. "Why are you still in the palace?"
He looked at her in surprise and found that she was much weaker than he had seen half a year ago. Her originally round face had become thinner, her pale face was full of illness, and there was a bright red mark on her forehead. The only thing that remained unchanged was her bright smile, which was more dazzling than the sun.
"I didn't want to leave at all." Zong Xueying sat on the ground and kept panting, even her tone of voice seemed weak.
"Why?" He frowned more tightly, wondering who asked her to stay in the palace? What's the purpose?
"Can we talk about it next time?" She tried hard to stand up, but she couldn't find the strength. She was swaying from side to side, as if she would fall back to the ground at any time. "I have to find a place to hide now."
"What are you doing?" Seeing how weak she was, he quickly grabbed her hand to prevent her from falling back, but his mouth remained unforgiving. "You did it什么亏心事，才怕被人找到？ "
Perhaps it was because he had been suffering from the same illness and knew the pain of illness that he couldn't help but reach out to help her, otherwise he would not want to deal with this little girl of unknown origin.
Her weakness made him feel a complex feeling in his heart. He didn't understand why his body recovered in just half a year, but she, who was originally healthy and mellow, became so sick and weak?
"I didn't do anything wrong, I just...sneaked out to take a breather." She flicked the tip of her tongue guiltily and smiled awkwardly. "Otherwise neither Mom nor Duo'er would let me step out of the room, and I would be suffocated to death."
Seeing the helpless expression on her face, he suddenly felt a slight tingling feeling in his heart, and he couldn't help but feel pity for her, because he understood her helplessness, and he had been the same way before. Until this moment, he could still deeply understand the suffocating feeling of being locked in a room without leaving the house.
"Since you're not feeling well, why bother running out?" Although he could understand the pain, he was still so angry that he couldn't help scolding her when he saw how little she cared about her body.
"Isn't it the same for you? Why can you do it but I can't?" She responded confidently and did not regard him as a king at all.
「什么？你……」居然敢顶他的嘴？ She really didn't want her life!
"King, can I ask you something?" Her lips turned white, and she looked even worse than before. "Before a person faints, do the things he sees in front of him become whiter and whiter, to the point where it is almost impossible to keep his eyes open?"
Lan Ting shouted in surprise: "Don't tell me that you're going to faint!"
"I don't want to, but I... really... can't hold it anymore..." As soon as she finished speaking, she closed her eyes and fell backwards, and she really fainted in front of him.
"Little girl!" Lan Ting jumped forward in surprise and hugged her. He protected her and sat down together on the ground, preventing her from falling or hurting anywhere. He patted her face gently, trying to wake her up, but he didn't expect that her skin was so cold that she could barely feel any warmth.
He was deeply shocked because this situation... was almost exactly the same as when he was still sick...
"Miss——"
「莹儿，你在哪儿？莹儿——」
Duo'er and another young and beautiful woman hurriedly ran into the cherry blossom forest and happened to see Zong Xueying passed out in Lan Ting's arms. The two of them gasped lightly and stopped aside. They didn't expect to meet Lan Ting here, and they were shocked.
The beautiful young woman was Zong Xueying's biological mother, Zong Xun. She regained her composure first and bowed politely to Lan Ting. "Wang, can you return Yinger to me? She is weak now and is not suitable to stay outside for too long."
"Do you recognize me?" Lan Ting frowned slightly, he had no impression of her at all.
「我当然认得。」宗薰淡淡一笑。
"What happened to her? Why is she so sick in just half a year?"
"I think...it's time to let the king know." Zong Xun said softly. "Please let me take Yinger back to the room first, and then I will try my best to explain the relationship between Wang and Yinger so that Wang can understand."
Lan Ting looked at Zong Xun in confusion, not understanding what she was trying to do, but since Zong Xueying was unconscious, he could only nod and ask Zong Xun to take her away quickly, so as not to delay her treatment.
他和这个小丫头之间能有什么关系？他就等着听她如何解释。
Lan Ting followed Zong Xun and the others to the dormitory where Zong Xueying currently lived, and watched Zong Xun carefully put Zong Xueying on the bed and cover her with a quilt.
Not long after, Queen Mother Jiang Yuan also came to the bedroom and ordered the maids to bring three chairs so that they could sit near the bed and explain the matter clearly.
Jiang Yuan said to Lan Ting: "Ting'er, she is Zong Xun, the leader of the Yin clan, and Zong Xueying's mother. She is also the person who made you recover. I never had the chance to tell you before, so why not take advantage of this moment and tell you together?Get it. "
"Mother, I don't understand, how did she make my son recover?" Lan Ting always thought that the imperial doctor found a new prescription that made his body gradually improve, but he didn't expect that it was not the case at all.
Zongxun opened his mouth to explain. "The real statement should be that Ying'er endured the illness on behalf of the king, so the king will recover day by day, while Ying'er will be troubled by the illness."
The Yin tribe is a mysterious small tribe that has passed down many mysterious magic skills from generation to generation, so it is coveted by all countries. In order to avoid pursuit by various countries, the Yin tribe has an erratic whereabouts and no fixed residence, so it is called the "Yin tribe".
